architecture.mechanism: Electronic engine immobilizer prevents unauthorized engine activation by requiring electronic authentication before the starting system engages.
architecture.intervention: Integrate an electronic engine immobilizer module into the Kia vehicle starting system that disables engine ignition and steering column lock release unless a cryptographically authenticated key transponder is detected, satisfying FMVSS requirements.
architecture.expected_effect: Unauthorized engine activation and vehicle theft will be prevented when the key is removed, achieving compliance with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards for starting systems.
architecture.falsification_test: Attempt to start the engine and release the steering lock using a non-authenticated mechanical key blank or bypass tool; if the engine cranks or steering unlocks without valid transponder authentication, the intervention has failed.
